rows.text: You enter a restaurant on Planet Adina. An old-fashioned sign in dazzling colors slowly rotates while informing patrons that dogs and Fools are not allowed entry. A tailless goldfish sits on a plate, its protruding fish eyes rotating as it chooses a taste experience that suits you.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Gourmet cooking grants a sampling of life. A banquet of Xianzhou flavors is more worthy of your tongue's consideration than a showing of immersia." The goldfish makes a strange gurgling sound in its throat.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You catch the sweet smell of appetizers wafting in the private room, carrying three parts tender youth, three parts lingering spices, and four parts plant fiber that's still warm.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As you put the appetizer mixed with the past into your mouth, it soaks into your taste buds. The stimulation on the tip of your tongue overlaps with your senses. You are donned in standard armor as you take a step forward to embrace your calling as a Cloud Knight.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Fully vigilant, you raise your lance toward the demons and abominations sowing chaos in the world.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Fully patient, you maintain order and stability for the craftsmen on-site.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
